places.name: Lorena's camp
places.note: Lorena waits here for Jake; Augustus swims in the cold water hole, Blue Duck rides in to water his horse, threatens, then leaves.
places.location_hint: camp by a small cold pool on rolling open plain in Texas, near the Hat Creek drive's cow camp; Jake left two days earlier

places.name: Hat Creek outfit's cow camp
places.note: Augustus urges Lorena to come stay at the drive's camp after Blue Duck appears; she refuses because the men stare.
places.location_hint: a short ride from Lorena's pool camp, on the trail north through Texas

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Lorena considers riding back there; she recalls feeling the same every day while living there.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Lorena's dream destination, which she hears is cool; Augustus warns that life there is still just life.

places.name: California
places.note: Lorena realizes Jake will not take her there and proposes Augustus go with her instead.

places.name: Alabama
places.note: Lorena's sickly brother stayed there with their grandmother.

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: Blue Duck threatens to mutilate Augustus if he ever comes north of it.

places.name: Red River
places.note: Blue Duck's Comancheros used to raid settlers along it, killing adults and stealing horses and children.
places.location_hint: Red River valley between Texas and Indian Territory

places.name: New Mexico
places.note: Western end of the range Blue Duck's gang raided.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Eastern end of the range Blue Duck's gang raided.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Augustus says he is headed there, to a woman named Clara, rather than to California.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Where Ogallala lies; Lorena scorns Augustus travelling that far for a woman.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Augustus promises Lorena a train ticket to California if they both reach it.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Lorena fears she will never leave it; Augustus says they are halfway out already.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Augustus says Texas does not extend much north of it.

places.name: Galveston
places.note: Augustus has heard of Blue Duck killing there and guesses he may be heading that way.

groups.label: Lorena
groups.hint: alone at the pool, still waiting for Jake, near the drive's cow camp

groups.label: Augustus
groups.hint: riding back toward the cow camp from Lorena's pool

groups.label: Blue Duck
groups.hint: rode off over a ridge from the pool; destination unknown
